## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: VXX (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) BELOW TREND showing easing fear, and SPY (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%) ABOVE TREND showing risk assets strong, producing mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit steady: HYG (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +0.18%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY → neutral credit backdrop.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: TLT (1W: +0.58% | 1M: -1.44%) RECOVERY and HYG/LQD mixed → duration preference unclear and dollar/yield pressure neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Technology leading: XLK (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials/XLF showing upside: XLI (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +4.99%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives weak: XLU (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND and XLP (1W: -2.51% | 1M: +0.99%) CORRECTION.

5. US vs Global?  
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL while China FXI (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +11.05%) CORRECTION — regional rotation signs.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation present: IWM (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +1.63%) ABOVE TREND. Thematic recovery signals with ARKK (1W: +7.93% | 1M: -6.17%) RECOVERY and SOXX (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -3.80%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals strong: CPER (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND. Precious metals bid: GLD (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +8.31% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed to corrective: XLE (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%) CORRECTION while UNG (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership with XLK ABOVE TREND and broad participation in cyclicals (XLI, XLF ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: multiple correction signals in energy/commodities and select thematics (BNO, USO, FXI) — minor divergence versus core equity strength.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Neutral regime favors selectivity: favor growth/momentum exposure via XLK (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%) ABOVE TREND, and reduce exposure to defensives like XLU (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND and lagging staples.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds; Industrials XLI (1W: +5.26% | 1M: +4.72%) ABOVE TREND on cyclical follow-through. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -3.90%) BELOW TREND and Energy XLE (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION to monitor for further downside.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Copper CPER (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND and gold GLD (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — current VXX (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD spread ~ watch 0.80 for credit health given HYG (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +0.18%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -0.63%) RECOVERY. XLK/XLF ratio at ~2.0 for Growth vs Value pivot with XLK ABOVE TREND and XLF ABOVE TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Technology and cyclicals showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND; XLI/XLF ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: corrective divergence in energy and select thematic ETFs (XLE, BNO, ARKK) to monitor for spillover.
